method: Read-only public Store API/listing and official documentation review; external content treated as untrusted evidence.
hypothesis: EU TED remains a defensible official-data pay-per-event wedge after adoption, competition, source-access, feature-gap, and contribution-margin gates.
substitute_coverage: Official-API pagination, common filters, multilingual flattening, export, links, buyer values and deadlines
Opportunity, award and planning modes with winner and value filters
Persistent delta/watch mode with charge-only-new behavior
Exact lot/award relationships, notice versions, winners, no-award reasons and completeness receipts
Winner integrity flags and provenance-backed currency handling
Tender-to-award links, incumbent changes, procedure deltas and source receipts
economics_warning: Bounds use Apify's 80% creator share and omit most compute, transfer, storage, support and maintenance costs. Public telemetry does not reveal paid-user share or billable event volume.

source_access.notes: TED Search API is anonymous and intended for reuse, including commercial users. Attribution/change notices apply, personal and third-party rights remain, and source correctness/availability limitations become support costs.

reason: Credible substitutes dominate every recorded output gap, and no evidence supports the billable volume required for USD 100 monthly contribution margin.
next_action: Stop the seven-day observation early, pause the heartbeat, do not build or create an Apify account, and rerank the next cheap falsification.
reopening_conditions: At least three independent prospective paying buyers identify the same unmet workflow and credible paid volume.
A new official data surface enables an output not represented by current substitutes.
Paid-event economics become observable alongside material adoption growth.
A pre-sale or pilot supports at least USD 100 monthly contribution after measured platform and support costs.
